name: recoil_app_play_state_on_try_become_current
description: RecoilApp_PlayState::OnTryBecomeCurrent runs play-state activation: loading checkpoints, mission/objective setup, start animations, input/frame reset, HUD reset, option reapplication, optional CD audio, and network top/chat-stack enable.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

A direct full-call smoke is intentionally not used because OnTryBecomeCurrent enters mission/player/HUD runtime initialization. The focused native smokes cover the critical composed callees and side effects while Binary Ninja/source evidence covers the orchestrating call order and branches.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL and assembly at 0x42eed0 validate the prologue load of g_HudSensorTracker.completedObjectiveCount, screensaver suppression in accelerated mode, Time::Reset and g_FrameDeltaTimeSec = 0.100000001f, network net-exit panel creation, effects-level fallback for software mode, HUD/common-sound/briefing loading checkpoints, objective load and briefing action build, mission resource/init branch, load-game versus new-game start animation branch, render/display/window option capture, input reset and one TickAndRenderFrame call, frame tick reset, play-state activation flag, half-res enable, ResetHudForMissionStart, mouse reacquire, option reapplication, optional CD track calculation, and network client transition-timer extension before enabling top/chat stacks.

The dependency frontier for 0x42eed0 has no visible source or functional blockers. The only unresolved token is the documented Binary Ninja x87 artifact at 0x42eff0 on HudSensorTracker::LoadObjectivesFromPath; it is not a real multi-return ABI contract.

The native smoke set verifies the play-state object initialization, the pre-render TickAndRenderFrame state capture and quit gate, mission core resource loading, objective loading from ZRD data, ResetHudForMissionStart single-player/network branches, and Briefing::StartForMission thread/runtime setup used by this activation path.
